answer: To create a fake identity, the attacker must mint a unique real-world anchor, like a state-licensed falconry permit, paying $100 and waiting 7 days. The next permit costs $100 and takes 7 more days. The anchor is scarce, one per identity, checked via official records. Cheating by buying a permit is risky; fake permits are rejected 90% of the time at $50,000 and 30 days. 100 fake identities cost $10,000 and 700 days. The signal of legitimacy must be strong, like an oasis in the desert of fakes. Echoes of real-world control prevent easy Sybil attacks.
